sources: https://blackduckmn.com/campground/ (City of Blackduck, Pine Tree Municipal Campground: North End and South End rate tables), read 2026-11-11

values.note: North End sites 20-33 have water and electric; South End sites 1-10 electric only, 11-19 no hookups (11-12 tent only). Sites 20 and 22 are small (10 ft wide, 30-40 ft long).

sites.source: https://blackduckmn.com/campground/ ('9 primitive camping sites, 10 sites with electric, 13 RV sites with electric and water'; North End table sites 20-33 and South End table sites 1-19 with 'Width/Length' 10'x30' to 20'x50' (19 Handicap 20'x60')), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: https://blackduckmn.com/campground/ (rate tables: 'Water Yes' on North End sites 20-33, 'No' on South End; '110V w/ 20 & 30 amp, 220V50amp' on sites 1, 31, 32 and the host site; no sewer listed on any site; the RV dump station serves), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://blackduckmn.com/campground/ ('Pine Tree Municipal Campground Includes: Hiking, trails, lake access (MN DNR boat ramp), playground equipment, public swim beach, picnic shelters, and RV dump station.'), read 2026-11-11

booking.source: https://blackduckmn.com/campground/ ('Open Camping Is Allowed. To guarantee a space we suggest that you book your reservation. Reservations can be made by contacting City Hall. Reservations will be taken until 12:00pm on Wednesday of each week for the following week during the camping season.' 'Call City Hall 218-835-4803'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: $22 a night with no hookups, $28 with electric, $30 with water and electric. Card payments carry a service fee.

fees.source: https://blackduckmn.com/campground/ (South End: sites 1-10 '$28', 11-19 '$22'; North End: sites 20-33 '$30'; 'service fees apply for all card transactions'), read 2026-11-11

season.source: https://blackduckmn.com/campground/ ('open May through October (weather dependent)'), read 2026-11-11

note: City of Blackduck campground in wooded Pine Tree Park on the east shore of Blackduck Lake, across the road from the municipal golf course; public swim beach, DNR boat ramp, trails and two reservable picnic shelters. Six people per site. --Claude
summary: City page and map read: 33 sites (14 water/electric $30, 10 electric $28, 9 no-hookup $22 incl. 2 tent), 20/30 A with 50 A on sites 1, 31, 32; dump, no sewer anywhere. Booking by phone to City Hall; walk-in allowed. Season now May-October. Not waterfront confirmed. Phone added; note cleaned.
flags: HOOKUPS sewer true -> false: neither rate table lists sewer; the stored 'electric, water and sewer' (derived from an old note) is wrong. The water/electric North End sites and the electric-only South End sites rely on the dump station.

SHOWERS: the stored derived showers: true is not supported by the current page or map (page lists 'Hiking, trails, lake access, playground equipment, public swim beach, picnic shelters, and RV dump station'); left alone, flagged for the reviewer.
SEASON 05-15..09-30 (derived) -> 05-01..10-31 per 'open May through October (weather dependent)'.

WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed: on Esri imagery and the park map both loops sit in woods 70-110 m east of the Blackduck Lake shore (north loop 47.7334,-94.5869; south loop ~47.7315,-94.5865), with a trail and forest between.
PHONE: none -> 218-835-4803 (City Hall, reservations). WEBSITE current.
Small sites: 20 (10'x40') and 22 (10'x30') are marked '(Small)'; most pads are 35-50 ft, so a 23-ft rig fits most sites.
